label: TP-Link EAP110-Outdoor
description: 300 Mbps 2.4 GHz outdoor access point: one 10/100 Ethernet port with 24 V passive PoE, weatherproof housing, Omada-managed.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: one 10/100 Mbps Ethernet port with 24 V passive PoE in; single-band 2.4 GHz 802.11n at up to 300 Mbps, which is the request's stated 300 Mbps class. There is no 5 GHz radio, so the spec carries one wlan interface - a lab cannot put this AP on a 5 GHz channel.
